sources.title: RBI: External Benchmark Based Lending (4 Sep 2019)
RBI: Reset of Floating Interest Rate on EMI based Personal Loans (18 Aug 2023)

entries.benchmark: External benchmark, usually the repo rate
entries.reset: At least once every three months
entries.note: Most new floating-rate retail loans must be linked to an external benchmark, and most banks use the repo rate. When the rate resets, borrowers can choose a higher EMI, a longer tenure, or both.

entries.benchmark: Bank's marginal cost of funds based lending rate
entries.reset: On the loan's reset date, often yearly
entries.note: Loans priced off a bank's internal MCLR follow policy moves later and usually by less.
